beats.title: Storm Warning and Departure from Town
beats.summary: While waiting for a response, Caelynn estimates a gathering storm will arrive in about seven hours. The group loads the wagon and heads back through town toward the north to beat the storm, hoping to warn Mossford and gather supplies. At town they interrupt a celebration; Stafl shouts rhyming warnings to the crowd and is confronted by the unhappy sheriff, who warns of rumors from a northern town called Edge of the World where cultists use music to convert others. The group warns the sheriff about tainted meat and Karsemine uses Thaumaturgy to show what to look for when people begin to change.

beats.title: Journey North, Storm Edge, and Conical Hill Camp
beats.summary: The group continues north, with Karsemine and Caelynn looking for high ground to camp. Their timing and navigation let the wagon just hit the edge of the storm and only get soaked. The rain smells savory and shows a sheen of magic. They spot a camping spot atop a conical hill, leave the wagon and animals below, and climb to a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove of trees. They determine they are three days from Mirathorn, with Mireward about five days out, and get a peaceful night's rest.

beats.title: Double Rainbow Detour and the Trail of Scales
beats.summary: After an uneventful night, Bonogo spots a huge double rainbow; Thrin thanks the group for taking him out of the forest. Bonogo is convinced something is where the rainbow ends and, reminded by Ephanna of an old Fey legend about making promises under a rainbow, the group makes a detour. They find an old overgrown trail and slash their way up. Karsemine notices an iridescent warm scale off the trail; Caelynn cannot identify it via arcana. Scales multiply as they climb, making Karsemine nervous. Caelynn creates Good Berries while Karsemine scouts ahead.

beats.title: The Drake Nest in the Bowl of Decay
beats.summary: The top of the hill is another giant bowl, this time filled with detritus and the smell of decay. Karsemine sneaks back and warns that something lives there. Bonogo insists on looking himself; Karsemine casts Pass Without a Trace and they sneak to the lip. Bonogo is overwhelmed by the scent of reptiles. Below they see between 40 and 50 winged reptiles the size of very large dogs, with iridescent rainbow-like scales, along with animal and human corpses and gear. Bonogo is convinced the treasure is on the human remains and calls it a big score.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-21:ad4ecd013dad:span:ad4ecd013dad:18-18
anchor_quotes: The top of the hill is again shaped like a giant bowl, just as before, but this time instead of water this bowl is filled with detritus and the horrible smell of decay.
Karsemine sneaks back to the group and warns them that something is definitely living here.
Down below on the floor of the bowl they can see a large amount of winged reptiles, between 40 and 50, and the remains of countless animal corpses along with human corpses with some remaining gear.
Despite the danger, Bonogo is convinced the “treasure” is on the human remains and tells the rest of the group that this is a big score waiting to be picked up.

beats.title: Young Drakes, Sneaking, and the Boots of Crowing Wings
beats.summary: As the group debates leaving, a large group of reptiles flies away and Karsemine identifies them as young drakes. Five would be a tough battle, so fighting the whole nest looks bad. Bonogo checks again, finding nine young drakes, two large elder drakes, and seven more on smaller nests. Sneaking closer with Karsemine's spell, he grabs a metal slab with buttons and beat-up old boots. He retreats; the boots turn out to be the Boots of Crowing Wings, granting extra jumping distance. Back at the wagon, Caelynn feels the storm building and Ephanna senses strange magic, so they seek shelter. On the next hill, Thrin helps craft a shelter from surrounding trees.

beats.title: Watches, the Flat Rock, and Caelynn's Devastating Call to Frank
beats.summary: Stafl takes first watch and sees a huge swarm of wings as the sky darkens. Ephanna takes the next watch and finds a strangely flat rock, which they keep. After sunrise Caelynn calls Mirathorn and finally reaches Frank, who sounds very hung over. He apologizes, saying the city resumed the Festival after a long night. Caelynn is upset, but Frank abruptly hangs up before she can tell him. Devastated, she tries to tell Lysandra, who fails to notice her distress; Caelynn walks away. Later Lysandra approaches, asks for tea, and notices Caelynn's state—then Lysandra bursts into tears and says she has investigated the person they spoke about in the city and sees how much the group does for her. Caelynn walks away again, not ready to talk.
